selector.rationale: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy best explains the patient's presentation with sudden-onset chest pain, tachycardia, and ECG changes, along with the absence of coronary artery disease and the presence of systolic apical ballooning on left ventriculography.

rejected.label: Adrenal carcinoma
rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence linking the adrenal mass to the patient's cardiac symptoms

rejected.label: Acute myocardial infarction
rejected.why: Normal coronary arteries on angiography contradict this diagnosis

rejected.label: Acute coronary syndrome
rejected.why: Normal coronary arteries and lack of evidence for acute plaque rupture

rejected.label: Pheochromocytoma
rejected.why: While possible given the adrenal mass, the primary presentation and diagnostic findings more strongly support Takotsubo cardiomyopathy
